references.text: Moses speaks to the heads of the tribes, who are here referred to as leaders in Israel
The heads of the tribes are mentioned as leaders bringing offerings
Moses appoints leaders over the people, including heads of the tribes
The expression 'this is what the Lord has commanded' is used to introduce God's commands
Moses is commanded to speak to the children of Israel and convey the words of the Lord
Moses gathers the assembly of Israel to convey what the Lord has commanded
Moses refers to the heads of the tribes as leaders over Israel
The heads of the tribes are mentioned in connection with the leadership of Israel
